title: Territory Energy
description: Simple energy-based territory claim system. Teams created with /team claims chunks and provides configurable block protection while powered.
body:
# Territory Energy (Forge 1.20.1)

Territory Energy is a lightweight, energy-based claim mod for PvP and survival servers. It uses a centralized Core Block to protect your base from enemy players.

### ⚙️ Fully Configurable

Mod can be customized via the config file! Server owners can easily turn protections on or off and adjust limits to fit their server's playstyle.

### 🛡️ Core Mechanics & Protections

Power to Protect: The Core requires standard Forge Energy (FE) to keep your territory safe. (Note: This mod does not include generators; you must use other tech mods for energy).

Team Territories: Place one Core per team to claim surrounding chunks. Overlapping and claim stealing are automatically blocked.

Anti-Griefing (Configurable): Prevent enemies from breaking blocks, placing blocks, or using explosives in your area.

Intruder Debuffs (Configurable): Apply the Mining Fatigue effect to enemies who enter your base.

### 🚀 How to Start

Create a team: /team add <name>

Join the team: /team join <name>

Place the Energy Core, connect it to a power source, and your territory is secure!
